slot_note: re-root of the ETL number after architecture 1 was found spent at the 2026-11-02 re-check
niche: a coastal steelworks' winter reserve of iron-bearing material in its ore yard, measured from a year of monthly drone surveys flown by two survey contractors in different grids and height systems
analyst_test: With both contractors' surveys aligned and the reserve procedure applied as written, a strong analyst takes each bed's December volume above a plane fitted through its toe, the stock surveyor's standard base, which the new bed's own bare survey and the year's book roll-forward both confirm, and files about 671,000 t, 50.1 days against the 52-day floor, nominating the winter option cargo.
domain_test: The deciding quantity is a stockpile inventory worked the way a stock-survey team integrates its surveys, each bed's volume between the December surface and the pad beneath it with the base surface conformed from the year's surveys across two contractors' grids and height systems; in another field's nouns the task is gone, because what decides is a pad consolidating under ore beds on reclaimed land, seen only where a bed was reclaimed to the pad.
layer2_pattern: own:stockpile base surface where the pad has settled under long-standing beds
layer1: two survey contractors on different grids (works grid, ETRS-TM35FIN) and height systems (N60, N2000)
ESRI ASCII grids against semicolon XYZ exports with decimal commas
NODATA cells where a machine stood on a bed
the laboratory's density unit changed mid-year (kg/m3 to t/m3)
the port's berth log in UTC against the works' Finnish time
a plant historian computing interval tonnage from totalisers, with catch-up after communication losses
a belt-scale integrator replaced mid-year, its totaliser restarting
a trading house shipping a producer's cargoes under its own name
stakeholder_role: the works' raw materials manager, who decides whether to nominate the supplier's winter option cargo

spine.entity: one surveyed point of the ore yard surface

world.geography: Finland (a fictional steelworks on the Gulf of Bothnia coast)

driver: The decisive quantity is the amount held above a surface that has sunk beneath the loads it carries, so under each load it lies below the level at the load's edge; the record shows that surface only on the occasions each load was taken away, and an amount taken against a surface through the load's edge leaves out the part filling the hollow.
driver_concrete: Each ore bed's tonnage at the December 2026 survey is its volume above the yard pad as the year's surveys expose it in the month the bed was reclaimed to the pad, aligned across the two contractors' grids and height systems, times its product's bulk density, not its volume above a plane through its toe, which leaves out the ore lying in the bowl the pad has settled into under years of stockpiling.
stump: The default path takes each bed's December volume above a plane fitted through its toe and files a reserve of about 671,000 t, 50.1 days against the 52-day floor, so it nominates the winter option cargo; the pad under the five long-standing beds has settled into bowls up to about two metres deep, and measured against the pad the year's clearances exposed the reserve is about 728,000 t, 54.2 days, and no cargo is needed.

lineage.fate: spent 2026-11-02 at the re-check under the new gates: the golden was the field's own POD-corrected aerial methane inventory (each plume over its detection probability fitted to the provider's controlled releases) applied as the literature states it, so the field's method was the top rung rather than rung 0 or 1 (Link, Reflex, Back-test, Second use and Shock fail on the honest anatomy); its shipped pack, target.zip 33e6d0c4, stays at the portal pending; re-rooted 2026-11-04 into a new domain, world, dataset and shell
lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is a period total of many intermittent sources seen only through a few snapshot surveys, each of which records a source only while it is active and then only with a probability that rises with its size, so a blank at a surveyed place is partly a miss: each detection has to stand for the instances its detection probability implies, measured on blind trials of known size, while counting blanks as zeros understates the units whose total sits in many small sources and carrying each detected source through the period overstates the units whose total sits in large intermittent ones.
lineage.stump: The default path averages each producer's plume rates over its passes and campaigns, counting every imaged site without a plume as zero, and rates eight producers low-methane, among them Anchell, Pinyon Draw, Pellisto and Ashmund (0.150, 0.155, 0.179 and 0.181 per cent), whose methane leaks from many 5 to 15 kg/h sources a pass catches less than half the time; carrying each detected source through the year instead rates none; only weighting each plume by one over the detection probability at its rate, fitted to the provider's blind controlled releases, rates the golden four.
lineage.niche: measurement-based methane intensity of gas producers from repeated aerial plume surveys, for an emissions data company's low-methane rating

notes: architecture 2 re-root 2026-11-04 after architecture 1 was found spent at the 2026-11-02 re-check (its golden was the field's own method applied as stated). Designed to the survivor anatomy: the field's method (a base through the toe) is rung 0 and validates on the new bed and on the book roll-forward; the decisive step is recognising that the long-standing beds violate its precondition (the pad under a bed continues the pad at its toe), forced by the year's own surveys with no filed method and no outside constant.
